workflows.quote: You will be prompted to set up two-step verification to keep your personal and financial information secure. Signing into your portal will periodically require both a password, as well as a security code, that will be sent via your preferred method.

workflows.label: Vendor team invitations
workflows.quote: You can invite a user via email and once they accept your invitation, they will have access to any of your assigned work orders and can invite other users.

workflows.label: Vendor team revocation
workflows.quote: You can also remove user access from your account via the Delete button. Invited users will also be able to remove other invited users.

workflows.label: Vendor payment preference
workflows.quote: Once you’ve set up two-step verification, you can confirm your payment preference and enter your payment information.

workflows.label: Vendor instant pay
workflows.quote: Please note that Instant Pay may not be available or provided by all property managers.

workflows.label: Vendor payment history PDF
workflows.quote: Click View Details to download the PDF version of the payment details.

workflows.label: Vendor compliance originals
workflows.quote: Any time your client requests compliance documents needing attention, you will receive an email notification. The email will prompt you to upload an updated PDF version of the document in the portal.

workflows.label: Accept or decline assigned work
workflows.quote: When you receive a new job in Vendor Portal, you may need to Accept or Decline the job.

workflows.label: Assigned work order search
workflows.quote: Search Bar: Use the search bar to enter the work order number (e.g., #250-1) or the property address at any time. Click on any result to navigate to the job's details page.

workflows.label: Requested estimate status
workflows.quote: Needs Estimate: You need to submit an estimate of this job

workflows.label: Customer estimate review
workflows.quote: Estimated: The customer needs to review your estimate

workflows.label: Competing repair estimates
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: Property managers have the option to request estimates from multiple vendors for each job. If you are selected, you will receive the job details in the “Estimates” Work Order Group in the Vendor Portal.

workflows.label: Vendor estimated cost submission
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: You will be able to submit an estimated cost, which will be submitted back to the property manager. If you are approved, this will move to the “In Progress” Work Order Group in the Vendor Portal and you will be notified via email.Adding a Note

workflows.label: Work order PDF
workflows.quote: You can download a PDF containing the details of the work order by clicking the Download PDF button at the top of the Details Page.

workflows.label: Resident availability scheduling
workflows.quote: Select any time and click Schedule Job to schedule the job. Your customer and the resident will be notified.

workflows.label: Appointment reminders
workflows.quote: We will send the resident a reminder 24 hours before the scheduled time.

workflows.label: Upload vendor invoice
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: If you have another tool you use to create your invoice, you can upload it to Vendor Portal and your customer will receive it.

workflows.label: Create itemized invoice
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: You can create a new invoice from scratch by creating billable items.

workflows.label: Edit vendor invoice
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: You can make changes to the invoice by clicking Edit and by clicking the three dots (Kebab) icon:

workflows.label: Work notes and photos
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: Notes allow you to provide messages and photos about the job to your customer. To add notes to your work order, click the Notes button at the bottom of a Work Order.

workflows.label: Vendor completion submission
workflows.section: Invoice, Estimates, Notes, and Work Done
workflows.quote: After completing the job, you can tell your customer that you have finished by clicking Work Done. This will change the status to Under Review or Needs Invoice if you have not added an invoice.

workflows.label: Resident account activation
workflows.quote: You'll receive an account activation email or text message from your property management company. Click Activate Now in the email, or tap the link in the email or text message to establish a strong password to activate your account.

workflows.label: Native resident mobile access
workflows.quote: Download the mobile app to stay logged into FolioSpace. Make payments, submit maintenance requests, and review important documents 24/7.

workflows.label: Resident two-factor authentication
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab. In the 2FA section, check Enable Two Factor Authentication, and hit save.

workflows.label: Account password recovery
workflows.quote: 3. An email with instructions to reset your password will be sent. Emails will only be sent if there is an active existing account. If the email is not in your inbox, please be sure to check spam for @appfolio.com emails.

workflows.label: Current and future charges
workflows.quote: Once logged in, you will land on the Home tab where you can view your current balance owed and details of current and future charges broken down by month.

workflows.label: One-time resident payment
workflows.quote: Click Pay Now to make a one-time payment.

workflows.label: Full or partial payment policy
workflows.quote: Next, choose to make your payment in full or to edit the amount. If online payments are required to be made in full, the payment amount will not be editable, and you will have the option of paying either the Balance Due, which includes past and current bills, or the Full Balance, which includes past, current, and any upcoming bills, including unposted, recurring bills.

workflows.label: Payment submission confirmation
workflows.quote: Once you have verified all your payment information, click Make This Payment Now. You will receive a confirmation email once the payment is successfully submitted, although this does not mean it has cleared your bank account yet. If you do not receive a confirmation email, you did not fully complete all necessary steps to submit the payment.

workflows.label: Autopay creation
workflows.quote: On the Home or Payments tab, click Set Up Autopay to create an automatically recurring payment

workflows.label: Autopay cancellation
workflows.section: How Do I Delete My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: You can stop any future auto payments from processing by navigating to the Payments tab and locating the Scheduled Payments block. Select Delete on the auto payment you have created. Please note that you cannot delete payments created by your roommates.

workflows.label: Skip one autopay
workflows.section: How Do I Skip My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: To skip the next month's payment, navigate to the Payments tab and locate the Scheduled Payments block. Click Skip this payment under the auto payment you have created (you cannot skip payments created by your roommates). The auto payment will resume after the skipped month.

workflows.label: Autopay amount edit
workflows.section: How Do I Change the Amount of My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Payments tab and locate the Scheduled Payments block. Click Edit under the auto payment you have created (you cannot edit payments created by your roommates). Update the amount of the payment then click Save at the bottom of the page.

workflows.label: Autopay bank or card change
workflows.section: How Do I Change the Payment Information of My Auto Payment?
workflows.quote: Update the bank account or card information on file then click Save at the bottom of the page. If you are changing your auto payment from a credit and debit card to an eCheck (or vice versa), then you’ll need to delete your auto payment then create a new one.

workflows.label: Autopay maximum limit
workflows.section: How Do I Change My Auto Payment Maximum Limit?
workflows.quote: If you have an existing pay-in-full auto payment, you will be required to set a maximum limit in order to prevent payments of an unexpected amount. If you would like to change this amount, navigate to the Payments tab and locate the Scheduled Payments block. Click edit under the auto payment you have created. Update the maximum amount and then click Save at the bottom of the page. Updating the maximum limit can be done at any time.

workflows.label: Resident account ledger
workflows.quote: Click the Payments tab, then click View full account ledger to see a detailed account of all charges and payments posted to your account. Please contact your property manager if you have any questions about the transactions displayed.

workflows.label: Delete saved payment method
workflows.section: Can I Delete My Saved Bank Account or Card?
workflows.quote: Yes, you can delete a saved bank account or card. Click the Account Profile tab and locate the Saved Payment Methods block. Under the saved payment method details, click the red Delete, then click Yes, Delete to confirm.

workflows.label: Retail cash payslip
workflows.section: Where Can I Find My Electronic Cash Payment Slip?
workflows.quote: You can find the electronic cash payment slip by navigating to the Payments tab, then clicking Download Payslip from the Electronic Cash Payments block. Alternatively, you may find your payslip as an attachment in your Shared Document tab.

workflows.label: Electronic lease signatures
workflows.section: How Do I Sign My Lease Electronically?
workflows.quote: Your electronic lease will appear as soon as you enter your move-in checklist in FolioSpace. Read through the document carefully and select the first initial line you see. You will be prompted to enter your full name and initials to create your electronic signature. As you read through your lease, click every initial and signature line that you see to provide your electronic signature until you have reached the end of the document.

workflows.label: Electronic renewal signatures
workflows.section: How Do I Renew My Lease Electronically?
workflows.quote: If you received an email that you have a lease renewal offer in FolioSpace, you can review the lease details on the Home tab. Review the offer(s) in the banner, then click View to begin signing the renewal offer of your choice.

workflows.label: Change electronic signature
workflows.section: How Do I Update My Electronic Signature for Signing Documents?
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab, then click Edit Electronic Signature in the Signature block. Enter your legal full name and initials, then click Save.

workflows.label: Move-in utility setup
workflows.section: How Do I Set Up My Utilities in FolioSpace?
workflows.quote: When you first activate your FolioSpace account, you will be welcomed to a move-in checklist that guides you through your key move-in tasks. If your property manager has selected utilities that you are responsible for, you will see them listed in the Set Up Utilities step. You may also choose to upload a document or manually enter details to confirm.

workflows.label: Utility concierge referral
workflows.section: How Do I Get Help With Utilities?
workflows.quote: Your property manager may offer a free Move-In Concierge to help with utilities and home services set up. The Concierge service is offered by AppFolio and staffed by professionals who can help connect you with your required gas, water, and electric providers. They can also help you find and sign up for internet, TV, and home security packages in your area.

workflows.label: Resident contact updates
workflows.quote: Navigate to the Account Profile tab and locate the Contact Information block. Here you can update the email address you use to log into your account, the phone number, mailing address, and vehicle information your property manager has on file for you.

workflows.label: Resident account deletion
workflows.section: I No Longer Rent With This Property Manager. How Do I Delete My Account?
workflows.quote: Please contact your property manager and ask them to delete the login information associated with your account.

workflows.label: Telephone maintenance intake
workflows.quote: The Smart Maintenance Contact Center uses intelligent AI to automate responses to residents 24/7 — no matter the time of day or night, so your team can focus on running your business. Long gone are the days of you or your residents having to fill out stacks of paperwork if something breaks. With multiple forms of communication, residents can easily submit a text message, make a quick call, or use their online resident portal to get started. From there, the request is received and the resident gets an AI-aided response within minutes to follow up and determine the urgency of the issue.

workflows.quote: The Smart Maintenance Contact Center uses intelligent AI to automate responses to residents 24/7 — no matter the time of day or night, so your team can focus on running your business. workflows.label: Maintenance emergency troubleshooting and preferred-vendor dispatch
workflows.quote: “Smart Maintenance monitors all work orders that come in, day or night, to see if it’s an emergency and helps residents troubleshoot or decide any next steps to ensure the property is not being damaged or that there are no health and safety issues. Then, the system contacts our preferred vendors, a choice that we put within the system. So ultimately, Smart Maintenance can take that work order and handle the situation without contacting anyone on our team. Right now with the staffing shortage that is going on nationwide, it’s just one extra support that you can have for those team members so they aren’t working overtime every single week.”

workflows.label: Combined report builder with drill-down

workflows.label: Rent roll column customization and saved export

workflows.quote: Once selected, a new screen will show the typical columns that are contained in the rent roll — Unit, Tenant, Status, Rent, Deposit, Lease Start, Lease End, etc. Below this, the user will see a section for adding columns from other reports. As long as the data is in the system, it can be added to your customized report. So, let’s say you want to add residents’ contact information to a current Rent Roll. You could do so by finding their phone number and email address in this section and adding it to the base report. This new report can then be exported or saved for future use.

workflows.label: Vacancy duration and trailing owner income reports
workflows.section: Customizing your reports in AppFolio Property Manager
workflows.quote: This is just one very basic example of the capabilities of Report Builder. Want to find out how long a unit has been vacant? Does an owner want to see a trailing five-year income statement? You can now get those insights in seconds, without needing to export and manually manipulate reports. With Report Builder, it’s easier than ever to make better business decisions and deliver the insights your stakeholders need. And the easier it is to extract data and create reports, the more efficient your operation can be.

workflows.quote: Quickly and easily develop workflow processes from pre-built templates and edit a wide range of process types to fit your specific company's needs.

workflows.quote: All changes made to specific pages will be tracked, giving you peace of mind to catch mistakes and quickly revert them when needed.

workflows.label: Staff two-factor authentication
workflows.quote: Two-factor authentication defends against phishers, fraudsters, and unwanted users from accessing your sensitive financial and personal data in AppFolio.
